item.title: Dems Incite Violence Against ICE
item.description: The heated rhetoric against ICE agents finally led to the death of a protester who used her car to obstruct operations and attack an officer.

item.title: Friday Short Cuts
item.description: Notable quotables from CNN, Jacob Frey, Jimmy Kimmel, Ken Jennings, JD Vance, Jonathan Turley, Scott Bessent, Cal Thomas, and more.

item.title: Contour Lines
item.description: I have a theorem I apply to climbing mountains: "For every downhill there is an equal to, or greater than, uphill ahead." Our spiritual journey is much like that.

item.title: Is a Wealth Tax Coming to California?
item.description: The failure of politicians to keep the books in order has left the Golden State desperate to make up for massive revenue losses.

item.title: Profiles of Valor: Capt Arthur Jackson (USMC)
item.description: "I still had ammo left, and I just figured I'd better get to as many of these [bunkers] as I can."

item.title: Housing Policy, Trump vs. Mamdani Style
item.description: Both men look to use the heavy hand of government to "fix" America's housing affordability problem, but they're coming at it from very different sides.

item.title: A Predictable Shooting in Portland
item.description: Just a day after a leftist agitator was shot in Minneapolis for trying to run over federal agents, a similar shooting happened in Portland.

item.title: Temporary ObamaCare Subsidies Forever
item.description: Good news — at least the House-passed legislation extending enhanced subsidies through 2028 isn't yet the law of the land.

item.title: Friday Executive News Summary
item.description: December jobs numbers, Russia spurns peace plan, billionaires begin to exit Commiefornia, Navy's USS Nimitz ends final deployment, and more.

item.title: Good News: MAHA Fixes Dietary Guidelines
item.description: The food pyramid has been flipped on its head, emphasizing whole foods and limiting processed foods while enraging leftists on social media.
